scenes.headline: How Drex Max turns Qwen into a decision model
scenes.sub: One forward pass, 255 codes, no generated text
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tallis! Drex Max answers typed questions with a probability for every option. It never writes a word.

scenes.text: The readout is Qwen's own output rows for the code letters, and training teaches the last token to point at the right one.
scenes.say: The idea: the head is not new. It is Qwen's own output rows for the code letters, and training teaches the last token to point at the right one.

items.text: Write the state and the options
items.say: Write the state, the question and the options, each under a one-token code.
Run the model once, with no decoding.
Take the hidden state of the last token.
Multiply by the 255 readout rows and take a softmax over the options you gave.

steps.label: 48 Gated DeltaNet layers
steps.say: Forty-eight layers are Gated DeltaNet and stay causal, left to right only.

steps.label: 16 full-attention layers
steps.say: Sixteen layers are full attention, and Drex Max makes them non-causal, so every token reads every token.

left.title: d3
left.say: Same base, same shape. d3 moved a little from Qwen, and its readout is nearly Qwen's rows.

right.title: Drex Max
right.say: Drex Max moved much further, in a different direction. It is not d3 trained further.

scenes.label: one call about a 1.64 MP photo
scenes.note: each question reads the photo again
scenes.say: One call about a photo costs about ninety-six teraflops, and every question reads the photo again.

items.text: Personal and research use is free
items.say: Personal and research use is free.

items.text: Above one million dollars: separate licence
items.say: A company above one million dollars in revenue or funding needs a separate licence.
Quantized and distilled copies count as derivatives under the same terms.

scenes.text: Same Qwen base and shape as d3, moved further and shared less. Check the licence before the leaderboard.
scenes.say: Same base and shape as d3, moved further, and sharing less across questions. Check the licence before the leaderboard.

recap: Qwen's output rows are the readout
Drex Max moved furthest from Qwen
A licence line decides who can use it
scenes.say: The readout is Qwen's own rows. Drex Max moved furthest. And a licence line decides who can use it.
